__comment_min_interactions__: Keep students and problems with at least this many responses
__comment_practice_cutoff__: Practice scores below this are set to 0 before each concept's scores are divided by their sum (0 = keep all)
__comment_item_residual_penalty__: Weight of the penalty on the free item residual delta_n (per response), so item difficulty comes from its concept-practice requirements first
__comment_practice_interaction_penalty__: Weight of the penalty on the practice-concept interaction g_psi, keeping it a small refinement
